notes: TRA-1 (size 1) 240x240: brown pentagon with an 8 white border on a white 240 square ground (the ground is only the pentagon). Outer pentagon: apex (120,0) R66, shoulders (0,50)/(240,50) R33, base 133 wide at 240 R33; inner brown pentagon offset 8 inward (radii reduced by 8). Arrow 66 wide (87 | 66 | 87), 107 high, top at 74 (50 | [24] | 107 | 59 = 240; the 24 is by subtraction). The '8' is read as the white border width. Generator draws the square ground behind the pentagon (no non-rectangular sheet outline).
